behavior_suite_metadata.name: clean_proof_v1
behavior_suite_metadata.negative_case_policy: Each target's negative cases include other selected behavior positives as hard negatives plus generic no-selected-behavior negatives.

caveats: Pilot feasibility sample; n=8 per behavior is not an impossibility result.
Tests source generation, not stored-probe decoding.
A revised source-generation protocol would require a new preregistration before proof use.
interpretation: Under the heldout-excluded full-pool source-generation protocol with deterministic accept-reject collection, all four behaviors produced 8 accepted pilot source subjects under the 0.40 heldout source-margin gate. No rejection was required under this seed schedule; this is source-generation feasibility only.
